policy.review_gate: New public datasets stop at REVIEW_READY until the user explicitly accepts or rejects them.
policy.owner_annotation: The project owner is not expected to perform routine manual pose annotation.
policy.storage: Large downloads, extracted datasets, caches, review media, and benchmark outputs must not be stored on C:.

datasets.name: JHMDB
datasets.maintainer: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems / Perceiving Systems
datasets.relevance: Fast sports and ball actions; shoot_ball, throw, swing_baseball, golf, jump and catch are directly useful stress cases.
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Manual 2D puppet joints for every frame; annotations include occluded joints but do not expose a per-joint visibility flag.
datasets.keypoints: 15 original joints; all 12 project evaluation joints map directly
datasets.occlusion_visibility: Occluded joints are annotated; visible versus occluded is not separable in pos_img.
datasets.license_summary: Max Planck PS:License 1.0; conservatively restricted to research use.
datasets.expected_size: 199,843,383 bytes for video, joints and official splits
datasets.known_mismatch: Low-resolution short clips; no ball/hand GT and no visible-versus-occluded joint flag.
datasets.usage_recommendation: Primary temporal/fast-action public GT candidate; research evaluation only.

datasets.name: Leeds Sports Pose
datasets.paper_project: Clustered Pose and Nonlinear Appearance Models for Human Pose Estimation (BMVC 2010)
datasets.maintainer: University of Leeds; mirror maintained by Hugging Face user LiuRunky
datasets.relevance: Static but difficult sports poses spanning athletics, badminton, baseball, gymnastics, parkour, soccer, tennis and volleyball.
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Manual 14-joint 2D coordinates with a binary occlusion flag.
datasets.keypoints: 14 original joints; all 12 project evaluation joints map directly
datasets.license_summary: The original README gives attribution/citation requirements but no explicit dataset or image relicensing grant.
datasets.access: official site unavailable; provenance-preserving Hugging Face mirror of the original archive
datasets.download_method: Git metadata plus direct resolve of full joints.mat and a deterministic 30-image review subset
datasets.expected_size: 10.9 MB for the mirror's complete 2,000-image source
datasets.downloaded_size: 587,351 bytes for full annotations plus the 30-image review subset
datasets.citation_requirements: Cite Johnson and Everingham, BMVC 2010; retain original JPEG attribution comments.
datasets.known_mismatch: Static low-resolution images; no temporal, hand, ball, or per-image sport label in the mirrored metadata.
datasets.usage_recommendation: High-value static sports control; do not use commercially until image rights are cleared.

datasets.name: MPII Human Pose
datasets.paper_project: 2D Human Pose Estimation: New Benchmark and State of the Art Analysis (CVPR 2014)
datasets.relevance: Broad activity taxonomy and explicit visibility; useful generalization control if selected images are acquired.
datasets.modality: still frames sampled from online videos
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Manual 16-joint coordinates, head box, person scale and per-joint visibility.
datasets.keypoints: 16 joints; all 12 project evaluation joints map directly
datasets.license_summary: Annotations use Simplified BSD, but the official page prohibits commercial image use.
datasets.access: official annotations acquired; 12.9 GB image archive intentionally not acquired
datasets.download_method: direct official annotation ZIP; image archive deferred
datasets.camera_setup: single unconstrained RGB view; source video references exist
datasets.known_mismatch: Full image archive is 12.9 GB and no official per-image endpoint is exposed.
datasets.usage_recommendation: Keep as a parsed-future candidate; not reviewable or benchmarkable in this run.

datasets.name: COCO 2017 Person Keypoints
datasets.paper_project: Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context; 2017 keypoint split
datasets.relevance: Strong general 17-point control with sports-object scenes, but no temporal evidence.
datasets.keypoints: 17 joints; all 12 project evaluation joints map directly
datasets.license_summary: Annotation terms and individual source-image licenses must be checked separately.
datasets.access: official archive and two mirrors timed out during this run
datasets.download_method: official annotation ZIP attempted directly to E:
datasets.expected_size: 252,907,541-byte annotation archive; selected images would be downloaded individually
datasets.citation_requirements: Cite Lin et al., ECCV 2014 and respect each image's source license.
datasets.ball_object_gt: object boxes are in a separate instances annotation file
datasets.known_mismatch: Static general imagery; sports-object filtering needs the separate instances annotations.
datasets.usage_recommendation: Retry later; never treat the partial archive as acquired data.

datasets.name: Penn Action
datasets.paper_project: Penn Action dataset / Robust Human Action Recognition from Novel Viewpoints
datasets.relevance: Temporal sports actions with per-frame joints, visibility and boxes; no explicit basketball class.
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Per-frame 13-joint coordinates, visibility and bounding boxes.
datasets.keypoints: 13 joints; core limb mapping is direct
datasets.license_summary: The project page and repository do not state an explicit data license.
datasets.access: official archive was reachable but projected to require 15+ hours at observed throughput
datasets.download_method: official tar.gz attempted directly to E:
datasets.citation_requirements: Cite the Penn Action project paper; no explicit data license was found.
datasets.known_mismatch: No explicit basketball class, no hand/ball GT, and unclear license.
datasets.usage_recommendation: Resume later if temporal diversity beyond JHMDB is needed.

datasets.name: PoseTrack21
datasets.relevance: High-quality multi-person temporal pose, occlusion, boxes and person identity.
datasets.ground_truth_quality: Human-verified temporal joints and tracking identities.
datasets.license_summary: Requires a signed data agreement and access token.
datasets.download_method: not attempted because signed agreement and token are mandatory
datasets.expected_size: not relied on before access approval
datasets.citation_requirements: Cite the PoseTrack21 benchmark paper and comply with the signed agreement.
datasets.known_mismatch: General video pose rather than sports-specific data; access is restricted.
datasets.usage_recommendation: Best future temporal control after user-led license approval.

datasets.name: Ego-Exo4D Body Pose
datasets.paper_project: Ego-Exo4D: Understanding Skilled Human Activity from First- and Third-Person Perspectives
datasets.maintainer: Meta FAIR and the Ego-Exo4D consortium
datasets.version: body-pose release documented in the current dataset portal
datasets.relevance: Basketball and skilled activities with synchronized ego/exo views and 2D/3D body annotations.
datasets.license_summary: Signed license and approval are required.
datasets.download_method: not attempted because signed license approval is mandatory
datasets.expected_size: large modular corpus; subset size depends on approved annotations and takes
datasets.citation_requirements: Cite the Ego-Exo4D paper and dataset release; comply with the signed license.
datasets.ball_object_gt: activity-dependent; not assumed until annotations are inspected
datasets.camera_setup: synchronized egocentric and multiple exocentric cameras
datasets.known_mismatch: Large, restricted, complex multiview corpus requiring conversion to product-like external RGB.
datasets.usage_recommendation: Highest basketball relevance after access is approved.

datasets.name: SportsPose
datasets.paper_project: SportsPose: A Dynamic 3D Sports Pose Dataset (CVPRW 2023)
datasets.relevance: Dynamic 3D sports motion and high-precision pose trajectories.
datasets.access: email request from an academic address required
datasets.download_method: not attempted because academic approval is mandatory
datasets.citation_requirements: Cite Ingwersen et al., CVPRW 2023 and follow the custom academic license.
datasets.camera_setup: multi-camera sports capture with 3D pose trajectories
datasets.known_mismatch: Academic-only access and no explicit basketball/hand/ball GT.
datasets.usage_recommendation: Valuable future 3D motion reference, not a product-use dataset.
